properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 14 at 3:36AM CDT until September 14 at 3:45AM CDT by NWS Omaha/Valley NE
properties.description:
The storm which prompted the warning has weakened below severe
limits, and no longer poses an immediate threat to life or property.
Therefore, the warning will be allowed to expire.  However, small
hail is still possible with this thunderstorm.

NWSheadline: THE SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WARNING FOR NORTHWESTERN OTOE AND SOUTHERN CASS COUNTIES WILL EXPIRE AT 345 AM CDT

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 14 at 3:29AM CDT until September 14 at 4:00AM CDT by NWS Omaha/Valley NE
properties.description:
SVROAX

The National Weather Service in Omaha has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southeastern Colfax County in northeastern Nebraska...
Southwestern Dodge County in east central Nebraska...
Northeastern Butler County in east central Nebraska...
Northwestern Saunders County in east central Nebraska...

* Until 400 AM CDT.

* At 329 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Abie, or 11
miles northeast of David City, moving northeast at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Damage to vehicles is expected.

* This severe thunderstorm will be near...
North Bend and Morse Bluff around 345 AM CDT.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 14 at 1:35AM MDT until September 14 at 4:30AM MDT by NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM
properties.description:
FFWEPZ

The National Weather Service in El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
North Central Grant County in southwestern New Mexico...

* Until 430 AM MDT.

* At 135 AM MDT, Additional rounds of thunderstorms with torrential
rainfall are moving into the Sapillo Creek Basin. 1 to 1.5 inches
of rain has fallen near Gattons Park and Sapillo Creek Campground.
Lower amounts have fallen further to the west, but additional
thunderstorms are approaching. Flash flooding in Sapillo Creek,
especially upstream or east of Lake Roberts, is expected. Several
low water crossings between Gattons Park and the Highway 15
Junction west of Lake Roberts will likely become flooded.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, highways, low
water crossings, as well as other poor drainage and
low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Lake Roberts village, Gattons Park, Sapillo Creek Valley, Lake
Roberts Heights and Trout Valley.

The worst flooding will likely occur where Sapillo Creek crosses
Highway 35 in low water crossings.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 13 at 10:52PM MST until September 14 at 5:00AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Havasu Creek basin in...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 500 AM MST Monday.

* At 1052 PM MST, Heavy rain has ended. Earlier between 0.5 and 1.5
inches of rain have fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Havasu Creek basin.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Havasu Creek basin.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Little Navajo Falls, Mooney Falls, Beaver Falls, Hualapai Hilltop,
Havasupai Reservation and Supai.

This includes the Colorado River between river miles 156 and 158.

This includes the following swimming holes...
All swimming holes on Havasu Creek near Supai.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Colorado River, Sinyella Canyon, Heather Wash, Pasture Wash, Little
Coyote Canyon, Havasu Creek and Black Tank Wash.
properties.instruction:
Campers and hikers should hustle to higher ground immediately! Stay
away from creeks and washes!

Foot bridges will be washed out in Supai Campground. Some campsites
will be flooded. Campers may be stranded in portions of the
campground.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 5:00 AM MST. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 5:00 AM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.
